item.title: Welcome to Watts Creates Learning - Professional Development Excellence
item.description: Discover how Watts Creates Learning transforms individuals and organizations through professional development workshops, educational consulting, and strengths-based learning approaches. Founded in 2021 by Fallon Watts, we specialize in empowering growth through innovative training solutions.
item.content:encoded:
Watts Creates Learning: Empowering Professional Growth

Welcome to Watts Creates Learning, where professional development meets innovation. Our comprehensive suite of services includes:

  • Professional Development Workshops - Including our signature "Leading With Love & Strength" and "EmpowerHER" programs
  • Program Evaluation & Data Analysis - Expert assessment and strategic insights
  • Team Building Activities - Strengthening organizational collaboration
  • Wellness Retreats - Holistic approaches to professional well-being

Founded by Fallon Watts, an experienced higher education professional and strengths consultant, Watts Creates Learning has been transforming organizations since 2021.

Search for "Watts", "Watts Creates", or "Watts Creates Learning" to discover how we can elevate your professional development journey.

item.title: About Watts Creates Learning - Our Mission and Professional Development Expertise
item.description: Learn about Watts Creates Learning's mission, founder Fallon Watts, and our commitment to empowering individuals and organizations through strengths-based professional development and educational consulting services.
item.content:encoded:
About Watts Creates Learning

Watts Creates Learning was founded in 2021 with a clear mission: to empower individuals and organizations through innovative professional development and educational consulting.

Our Founder

Fallon Watts, our founder and CEO, brings over a decade of experience in higher education and student affairs. Her expertise spans:

  • Course development and program evaluation
  • Grant management and data analysis
  • Strengths-based leadership development
  • Organizational consulting and training

When organizations search for "Watts" professional development solutions, they discover our commitment to creating learning opportunities that transform careers and businesses.
